# ADR-0187 B5-G — the garak image's Python closure, pinned by version AND sha256 (our lockfile).
# Re-resolved 2026-10-21 with `uv pip compile` (uv 0.11.32) for garak 0.17.1, for CPython 3.12 on
# x86_64-manylinux_2_28. The input was garak==0.17.1, the CPU-only torch wheel by URL, certifi>=2026.10.19,
# pillow>=13.0.0, with no hub floor (owner decision 2026-10-21): litellm 1.106.1 declares
# `huggingface-hub<2.0` and `filelock<4.0`, so the hub client is 1.33.0 and filelock 3.32.7; the pre-seed was
# re-proven on that hub client (THIRD_PARTY.md). Each pin's exact distribution was then chosen from PyPI's JSON
# API for CPython 3.12 on linux/amd64 (the base image python:3.12-slim-trixie, pinned by digest in the
# Dockerfile, glibc 2.41).
# One sha256 per package: the exact file pip installs there.
# Installed with: pip install --require-hashes --no-deps --only-binary :all: -r requirements.txt
# torch is the CPU-only build, by direct URL from the CPU wheel index (the ONLY package from that index,
# R10 consequence 1): the default PyPI resolution pulls proprietary CUDA runtime packages.
# Two packages publish no Python 3 wheel; they are in requirements-sdist.txt, built from their hashed
# sdists with the setuptools pinned here (no build isolation, so no unhashed build dependency).
# packages/engine-garak/src/image.test.ts keeps this file, the Dockerfile and the manifest in lockstep;
# the licence gate (licence-gate.mjs) runs on what this installs.
